To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the attention mechanism is a useful tool for training a GAN; (2) attention transfer can be applied to GANs to improve image quality; (3) the generated attention maps can be used for object localization.

(i) GANs are capable of learning the mapping between two domains; (ii) the discriminator is not capable of detecting the regions of interest; (iii) the proposed method allows us to train the discriminator to put emphasize on the regions of interests; (iv) this results in a better quality of the generated samples; and (v) the proposed method can be used to perform weakly supervised segmentation.
we propose to use attention maps to improve the quality and localization of GANs.
